The store is Pine Crossing. I've replied to you in the thread in #inc-tansley-carrier-api.

I found it in #central-team, a channel you're in. On 9 June 2026, during the Marrow Agrisupply rollout escalation, Priyanka posted that the Pine Crossing morning receiver's appointment screen showed only the afternoon shift. A driver had turned up at 7:10 the day before, and they wrote his trailer number on a sticky note.

You said then that you'd check the shift template and get support to reproduce it with the store login. I couldn't find anything later, in the channels or files you can see, saying it was fixed. So I can't tell you its current status for the QBR deck.
